name: 赛博霓虹
description: 深色底+霓虹青/品红发光效果+等宽字体感，适合前沿科技、AI话题

styles.h1: font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #00e5ff; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.3); margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #e040fb; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #c8c8c8; line-height: 1.8; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #00e5ff; background: rgba(224,64,251,0.08); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; color: #c8c8c8; line-height: 1.8; font-style: italic; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(224,64,251,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(224,64,251,0.25);
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #c8c8c8; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; font-style: normal; background: transparent; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0,229,255,0.2); background: #1a1a1a; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(0,229,255,0.4), rgba(224,64,251,0.4), transparent); border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(0,229,255,0.1); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 90%; color: #00e5ff; font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #1a1a2e; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border-top: 2px solid #00e5ff; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,229,255,0.1); color: #c8c8c8; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #16162a;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #c8c8c8; font-size: 14px; font-family: SF Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 15px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;
styles.th: background: rgba(0,229,255,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.15); text-align: left; font-weight: bold; color: #00e5ff;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: rgba(0,229,255,0.15); color: #00e5ff; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.3);
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #c8c8c8; line-height: 1.8; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #666666; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
styles.h4: font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; color: #e040fb; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #888888; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #666666; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
